items.en: to begin to; to start doing
items.extra: commencer à + 不定式
items.fr: Pia [commence à] lire un roman policier dans le train.
items.sen: Pia starts reading a detective novel on the train.
items.szh: 皮娅在火车上开始读一本侦探小说。
items.scene: Pia, seated by a train window, has just opened a thick novel at the very first page, bookmark still at the front, her finger on the first line; the cover shows a magnifying glass. The book being opened at page one must be the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 开始做一件事，朝着它出发：commencer à。

items.extra: apprendre à + 不定式；apprendre à qqn à + 不定式（教某人做）
items.fr: Lison [apprend à] conduire avec son oncle sur un parking vide.
items.sen: Lison is learning to drive with her uncle in an empty car park.
items.szh: 莉松在空停车场跟着叔叔学开车。
items.scene: Lison grips the steering wheel of a small car with learner concentration while an older man in the passenger seat points ahead; cones are scattered on an empty car park. Show clearly that she is a beginner practising. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 学着去做：apprendre à + 动词原形。

items.en: to manage to; to succeed in
items.extra: arriver à + 不定式；否定：ne pas arriver à
items.fr: Avec une chaise, Pia [arrive à] attraper le pot de confiture.
items.sen: With a chair, Pia manages to reach the jar of jam.
items.szh: 皮娅踩着椅子，终于够到了果酱罐。
items.scene: Pia stands on a chair on tiptoe, fingertips just closing around a jam jar on the top shelf, with a relieved smile; the height of the shelf shows it was difficult. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: arriver à 不是“到达”，是“终于做到”。

items.en: to succeed in; to manage to
items.extra: réussir à + 不定式
items.fr: Après trois essais, Lison [réussit à] ouvrir la vieille porte.
items.sen: After three attempts, Lison succeeds in opening the old door.
items.szh: 试了三次之后，莉松成功打开了那扇旧门。
items.scene: Lison pushes open a heavy old wooden door that finally gives way, a big rusty key in the lock; two bent keys lie on the ground to show earlier failed attempts, and she raises a fist in triumph. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 成功做成：réussir à；和 arriver à 意思接近，更强调“成功”。

items.en: to continue to; to keep on
items.extra: continuer à + 不定式（也可以说 continuer de）
items.fr: Malgré la pluie, Ninon [continue à] courir dans le parc.
items.sen: Despite the rain, Ninon keeps running in the park.
items.szh: 尽管下雨，妮侬还是继续在公园里跑步。
items.scene: Ninon jogs steadily along a park path in pouring rain, soaked but determined, while other runners have stopped under a shelter in the background. The contrast between her and those who stopped is the point. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 别人停了她不停：continuer à。

items.extra: hésiter à + 不定式
items.fr: Pia [hésite à] sauter dans l'eau froide du lac.
items.sen: Pia hesitates to jump into the cold water of the lake.
items.szh: 皮娅犹豫着要不要跳进冰冷的湖水里。
items.scene: Pia stands at the very edge of a wooden jetty in a swimsuit, one foot forward, arms hugging herself, looking doubtfully at the cold blue lake with small ice-blue ripples; she has not jumped. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 站在跳板边上犹豫：hésiter à + 动词原形。

items.extra: s'habituer à + 不定式 / 名词；代词用 y：je m'y habitue
items.fr: Lison [s'habitue à] se lever tôt pour aller au travail.
items.sen: Lison is getting used to getting up early to go to work.
items.szh: 莉松渐渐习惯了早起去上班。
items.scene: Two-panel picture: on the left Lison struggles out of bed at dawn, exhausted; on the right, same alarm clock and same dawn light, she gets up easily and smiling. The change between the panels shows getting used to it. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 慢慢适应某件事：s'habituer à。

items.extra: aider qqn à + 不定式；人是直接宾语：je l'aide à…
items.fr: Pia est fatiguée, alors Ninon l'[aide à] porter ses valises.
items.sen: Pia is tired, so Ninon helps her carry her suitcases.
items.szh: 皮娅累了，妮侬就帮她提行李箱。
items.scene: Pia, visibly tired, drags one suitcase while Ninon cheerfully lifts the other two for her on a station platform. Both must be clearly recognisable, with Ninon doing the helping. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 帮“某人”做“某事”：aider 人 à 动词；人是直接宾语（l'aide）。

items.extra: inviter qqn à + 不定式 / 名词
items.fr: Lison nous [invite à] dîner chez elle samedi soir.
items.sen: Lison invites us to have dinner at her place on Saturday evening.
items.szh: 莉松邀请我们周六晚上去她家吃晚饭。
items.scene: Lison stands at her open front door with a welcoming gesture toward the viewer, a table set for dinner with candles visible inside. Her inviting gesture toward us is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Flat vector illustration: clean shapes, soft gradients, limited warm palette
items.hook: 请人去做什么：inviter 人 à。

items.extra: s'intéresser à qqch / qqn；代词用 y：je m'y intéresse
items.fr: Depuis l'enfance, Pia [s'intéresse aux] étoiles et aux planètes.
items.sen: Since childhood, Pia has been interested in stars and planets.
items.szh: 皮娅从小就对星星和行星感兴趣。
items.scene: Pia looks through a telescope on a balcony at night, surrounded by star charts, a model of the solar system and space books; her fascinated expression and all the astronomy objects show her interest. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 兴趣指向什么就用 à：s'intéresser à。

items.extra: participer à qqch；代词用 y
items.fr: Ninon [participe à] une course de dix kilomètres dimanche.
items.sen: Ninon is taking part in a ten-kilometre race on Sunday.
items.szh: 妮侬星期天参加一场十公里赛跑。
items.scene: Ninon runs in the middle of a crowd of runners in a street race, wearing a blank race bib, under a start arch with no text. She is one participant among many. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 亲自参与其中：participer à；和只是到场观看的 assister à 不同。

items.en: to attend; to be present at
items.extra: assister à qqch；不是“帮助”
items.fr: Les trois amies [assistent à] un concert en plein air.
items.sen: The three friends attend an open-air concert.
items.szh: 三个朋友去看了一场露天音乐会。
items.scene: Ninon, Pia and Lison stand in the audience of an open-air concert at dusk, seen from behind and in profile, watching a band on a distant stage. They are spectators, not performers. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: assister à 是“到场观看”，不是英语的 assist（帮助）。

items.en: to think about; to reflect on
items.extra: réfléchir à qqch；代词用 y：j'y réfléchis
items.fr: Lison [réfléchit à] son avenir en regardant la mer.
items.sen: Lison thinks about her future while looking at the sea.
items.szh: 莉松望着大海，思考自己的未来。
items.scene: Lison sits on a rock facing the sea, chin on her hand in a thoughtful pose; a thought bubble shows a winding road with several branching paths and tiny symbolic icons (no text). Deep, careful thinking is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 认真想一个问题：réfléchir à；比 penser à 更“动脑筋”。

items.extra: répondre à qqn / à qqch；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Pia [répond à] tous ses messages avant le petit-déjeuner.
items.sen: Pia replies to all her messages before breakfast.
items.szh: 皮娅在吃早饭前回复了所有消息。
items.scene: Pia in pyjamas types quickly on her phone at a breakfast table that is still untouched; speech-bubble icons without text fly from her phone, each ticked with a check mark shape. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 法语里回答“给”某人：répondre à，不能省 à。

items.extra: ressembler à qqn / qqch；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Avec ce chapeau, Ninon [ressemble à] sa grand-mère sur la photo.
items.sen: With this hat, Ninon looks like her grandmother in the photo.
items.szh: 戴上这顶帽子，妮侬很像照片里的祖母。
items.scene: Ninon wears an old-fashioned hat and holds up a framed old photograph of a woman with the same hat, same wavy hair and same smile next to her own face. The side-by-side likeness is the point. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 像“谁”要加 à：ressembler à。

items.extra: téléphoner à qqn；人用 lui / leur（不是 le / la）
items.fr: Chaque dimanche, Lison [téléphone à] ses parents pour prendre des nouvelles.
items.sen: Every Sunday, Lison phones her parents to hear their news.
items.szh: 每个星期天，莉松都给父母打电话问候近况。
items.scene: Split scene: Lison on her sofa talks into a phone; on the other side an older couple share one phone and smile. A wall calendar with one day circled (no numbers) suggests a weekly habit. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 打电话“给”谁：téléphoner à，所以代词是 lui。

items.extra: obéir à qqn / à qqch；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Le chien de Pia [obéit à] tous ses ordres sans hésiter.
items.sen: Pia's dog obeys all her commands without hesitating.
items.szh: 皮娅的狗毫不犹豫地听从她所有的口令。
items.scene: Pia raises one hand in a clear 'sit' signal and a dog sits perfectly straight in front of her, eyes on her hand, while a ball rolls past ignored. The dog's obedience is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 服从“于”谁：obéir à。

items.extra: renoncer à qqch / à + 不定式；代词用 y
items.fr: À cause de la neige, Ninon [renonce à] son voyage à la montagne.
items.sen: Because of the snow, Ninon gives up her trip to the mountains.
items.szh: 因为下雪，妮侬放弃了去山里的旅行。
items.scene: Ninon, dressed for a mountain trip, sadly puts her packed rucksack and skis back into a cupboard while heavy snow blocks the road outside the window. Giving the plan up is the point. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 放弃原来想做的事：renoncer à。

items.extra: appartenir à qqn；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Ce vieux vélo rouge [appartient à] Lison depuis dix ans.
items.sen: This old red bike has belonged to Lison for ten years.
items.szh: 这辆红色的旧自行车归莉松所有已经十年了。
items.scene: Lison stands proudly with a hand on the saddle of a worn old red bicycle that has a ribbon in her signature red tied to the handlebar; she hugs it like a long-time possession. Ownership is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 东西属于“谁”：appartenir à。

items.en: to speak to; to go and ask (an office, a person)
items.extra: s'adresser à qqn / à un service
items.fr: Pour changer son billet, Pia [s'adresse au] guichet de la gare.
items.sen: To change her ticket, Pia goes to the ticket office at the station.
items.szh: 为了改签车票，皮娅去火车站的售票窗口办理。
items.scene: Pia holds out a train ticket to a clerk behind a station counter window and points to it questioningly; signs are blank pictograms. She is turning to the right person for help. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 有事找对的人或窗口：s'adresser à。

items.extra: faire confiance à qqn；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Pia ferme les yeux et [fait confiance à] Ninon pour la guider.
items.sen: Pia closes her eyes and trusts Ninon to guide her.
items.szh: 皮娅闭上眼睛，信任妮侬带着她走。
items.scene: Pia walks with her eyes closed and a calm smile along a narrow garden path with small obstacles, while Ninon holds her hand and leads her carefully. Pia's closed eyes and relaxed face show trust. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Watercolor storybook illustration: translucent pigment, visible paper texture, soft edges
items.hook: 把信任“交给”谁：faire confiance à。

items.extra: décider de + 不定式
items.fr: Lison [a décidé d']apprendre le violon cette année.
items.sen: Lison has decided to learn the violin this year.
items.szh: 莉松决定今年学小提琴。
items.scene: Lison stands in a music shop and firmly points at one violin among several instruments, nodding decisively to the shopkeeper. The firm choice is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 做了决定去做：décider de + 动词原形。

items.extra: essayer de + 不定式
items.fr: Ninon [essaie de] réparer son vélo toute seule.
items.sen: Ninon tries to repair her bike all by herself.
items.szh: 妮侬试着自己修自行车。
items.scene: Ninon kneels beside an upside-down bicycle with a loose chain, tools spread around, tongue out in concentration and grease on her cheek; the repair is clearly not finished yet. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 试一试，还不一定成功：essayer de。

items.extra: oublier de + 不定式
items.fr: Pia [a oublié d']éteindre la lumière en partant.
items.sen: Pia forgot to turn off the light when she left.
items.szh: 皮娅出门时忘了关灯。
items.scene: Pia is already walking away down the street with her bag, while behind her every window of her flat is still brightly lit in broad daylight. The lights left on are the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 忘了去做：oublier de + 动词原形。

items.extra: finir de + 不定式
items.fr: Lison [finit de] peindre le mur avant le dîner.
items.sen: Lison finishes painting the wall before dinner.
items.szh: 莉松在晚饭前把墙刷完了。
items.scene: Lison on a small ladder paints the very last small unpainted corner of an otherwise freshly painted wall, paint roller in hand; a set dinner table waits in the background. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 把正在做的事做完：finir de。

items.extra: arrêter de + 不定式
items.fr: Depuis janvier, Ninon [a arrêté de] manger des bonbons.
items.sen: Since January, Ninon has stopped eating sweets.
items.szh: 从一月起，妮侬不再吃糖果了。
items.scene: Ninon pushes away a big bowl of sweets with a flat hand and turns her head toward a bowl of fruit; a calendar with crossed-off days (no numbers) shows time passing. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 不再做了：arrêter de。

items.extra: éviter de + 不定式；éviter qqch
items.fr: Pia [évite de] prendre la voiture quand il neige.
items.sen: Pia avoids taking the car when it snows.
items.szh: 下雪的时候，皮娅尽量不开车。
items.scene: On a snowy morning Pia walks past her snow-covered parked car, leaving the keys hanging by the door, and heads to a tram stop instead. Choosing not to drive is the point. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 有意绕开不做：éviter de。

items.extra: refuser de + 不定式
items.fr: Le chat de Lison [refuse de] entrer dans son panier.
items.sen: Lison's cat refuses to get into its basket.
items.szh: 莉松的猫不肯进它的篮子。
items.scene: Lison gently pushes a cat toward a travel basket, but the cat braces all four paws against the opening with a stubborn face. The cat's refusal is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 就是不肯：refuser de。

items.extra: accepter de + 不定式
items.fr: Ninon [accepte de] garder le chien de Pia pendant les vacances.
items.sen: Ninon agrees to look after Pia's dog during the holidays.
items.szh: 妮侬答应在假期里帮皮娅照看狗。
items.scene: Pia, with a suitcase, hands a dog's lead to Ninon, who takes it with an open, willing smile and a nod. Ninon saying yes is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 点头答应去做：accepter de，和 refuser de 相反。

items.extra: promettre (à qqn) de + 不定式
items.fr: Pia [promet de] rentrer avant minuit.
items.sen: Pia promises to come home before midnight.
items.szh: 皮娅保证在午夜之前回家。
items.scene: At the front door at night, Pia raises one hand in a solemn promise gesture toward Ninon, who points at a wall clock without numerals whose hands are close to the top. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 许下诺言要做到：promettre de。

items.extra: rêver de + 不定式 / 名词
items.fr: Lison [rêve de] faire le tour du monde en bateau.
items.sen: Lison dreams of sailing around the world.
items.szh: 莉松梦想着坐船环游世界。
items.scene: Lison leans on a harbour railing gazing at the horizon; a dreamy cloud bubble above her shows a small sailing boat circling a globe. The daydream is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Colored pencil drawing: fine hatching, gentle pastel tones, white paper showing through
items.hook: 梦想着某件事：rêver de。

items.extra: se souvenir de qqch / qqn；代词用 en：je m'en souviens
items.fr: Ninon [se souvient de] son premier jour d'école.
items.sen: Ninon remembers her first day at school.
items.szh: 妮侬还记得自己上学的第一天。
items.scene: Adult Ninon looks at an old school satchel with a soft smile; a sepia-toned memory bubble shows her as a small girl with the same red wavy hair standing at a school gate. The memory bubble is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book painting: opaque matte colours, bold simple forms
items.hook: 回忆“起”某事：se souvenir de；se rappeler 后面不加 de。

items.en: to look after; to take care of
items.extra: s'occuper de qqn / qqch；代词用 en
items.fr: Le week-end, Pia [s'occupe des] plantes de sa voisine.
items.sen: At the weekend, Pia looks after her neighbour's plants.
items.szh: 周末，皮娅照料邻居家的植物。
items.scene: Pia waters a row of pot plants on a neighbour's balcony, wiping a leaf with care, with a spare key on a ribbon around her wrist to show the plants are not hers. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book painting: opaque matte colours, bold simple forms
items.hook: 把某件事揽过来照管：s'occuper de。

items.en: to make the most of; to take advantage of
items.extra: profiter de qqch；代词用 en：j'en profite
items.fr: Lison [profite du] soleil pour lire sur le balcon.
items.sen: Lison makes the most of the sun to read on the balcony.
items.szh: 莉松趁着阳光好，在阳台上看书。
items.scene: Lison stretches out on a balcony chair in bright sunshine with a book and a cold drink, face turned happily to the sun; clouds are far away. Enjoying the good moment is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book painting: opaque matte colours, bold simple forms
items.hook: 把好机会用起来：profiter de。

items.extra: dépendre de qqch / qqn；ça dépend de…
items.fr: Le pique-nique de demain [dépend de] la météo.
items.sen: Tomorrow's picnic depends on the weather.
items.szh: 明天的野餐要看天气。
items.scene: A packed picnic basket sits by the door between two thought panels: on one side a sunny meadow with a picnic blanket, on the other a rainy window; Ninon looks up at a half-sunny, half-cloudy sky, undecided. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book painting: opaque matte colours, bold simple forms
items.hook: 结果要看什么：dépendre de。

items.extra: se moquer de qqn / qqch
items.fr: Lison [se moque du] nouveau chapeau de Pia en riant.
items.sen: Lison laughs and makes fun of Pia's new hat.
items.szh: 莉松笑着取笑皮娅的新帽子。
items.scene: Pia proudly wears an enormous, ridiculous feathered hat while Lison points at it and laughs behind her hand in a friendly, teasing way; Pia pouts. Keep it playful, not cruel. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book painting: opaque matte colours, bold simple forms
items.hook: 拿某人某物开玩笑：se moquer de。

items.extra: se plaindre de qqch / qqn；代词用 en
items.fr: Ninon [se plaint du] bruit de ses voisins tous les soirs.
items.sen: Ninon complains about her neighbours' noise every evening.
items.szh: 妮侬每天晚上都抱怨邻居的噪音。
items.scene: Ninon, hands over her ears and frowning, gestures angrily at the ceiling, from which jagged sound waves and musical-note shapes without text come down. Her complaining gesture is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book painting: opaque matte colours, bold simple forms
items.hook: 抱怨的对象用 de：se plaindre de。

items.en: to approach; to come closer to
items.extra: s'approcher de qqn / qqch
items.fr: Pia [s'approche du] petit chat sans faire de bruit.
items.sen: Pia comes closer to the little cat without making a sound.
items.szh: 皮娅悄悄地靠近那只小猫。
items.scene: Pia tiptoes with one finger on her lips toward a small kitten sleeping on a garden bench; dotted footstep marks behind her show her getting closer. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Gouache picture-book painting: opaque matte colours, bold simple forms
items.hook: 向它靠近，离它越来越近：s'approcher de。

items.extra: demander à qqn de + 不定式；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Il fait froid, alors Ninon lui [demande de] fermer la fenêtre.
items.sen: It is cold, so Ninon asks her to close the window.
items.szh: 天气冷，妮侬就请她把窗户关上。
items.scene: Ninon, wrapped in a blanket and shivering, politely points to an open window with snowflakes blowing in, speaking to Lison who stands right next to the window with her hand on the handle. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Paper cut-out collage: layered coloured paper, crisp shadows
items.hook: 请“人”做“事”：demander à 人 de 动词；人变代词是 lui。

items.extra: dire à qqn de + 不定式；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: La mère de Pia lui [dit de] ranger sa chambre.
items.sen: Pia's mother tells her to tidy her room.
items.szh: 皮娅的妈妈叫她收拾房间。
items.scene: An older woman stands in the doorway of a very messy bedroom, pointing firmly at clothes on the floor, while Pia sits on the bed looking guilty. The instruction being given is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Paper cut-out collage: layered coloured paper, crisp shadows
items.hook: dire 后面加 de + 动词，是“叫人去做”，不是“说”。

items.extra: conseiller à qqn de + 不定式；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Le médecin lui [conseille de] dormir huit heures par nuit.
items.sen: The doctor advises her to sleep eight hours a night.
items.szh: 医生建议她每晚睡八个小时。
items.scene: A friendly doctor in a white coat speaks kindly to a tired Lison with dark circles under her eyes, holding up a small picture card of a bed and a moon. Advice, not an order: a gentle open-hand gesture. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Paper cut-out collage: layered coloured paper, crisp shadows
items.hook: 给人出主意：conseiller à 人 de 动词。

items.extra: permettre à qqn de + 不定式；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Ses parents lui [permettent de] sortir jusqu'à minuit.
items.sen: Her parents allow her to stay out until midnight.
items.szh: 父母允许她在外面待到午夜。
items.scene: At the front door in the evening, two smiling parents hand a house key to Pia, who is dressed to go out, and wave her off; a clock without numerals shows a late hour. Their approving gesture is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Paper cut-out collage: layered coloured paper, crisp shadows
items.hook: 点头放行：permettre à 人 de 动词，和 interdire 相反。

items.extra: interdire à qqn de + 不定式；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Le gardien leur [interdit de] marcher sur la pelouse.
items.sen: The park keeper forbids them to walk on the grass.
items.szh: 管理员不许他们踩草坪。
items.scene: A park keeper in uniform holds up a flat hand in a stop gesture and blows a whistle at Ninon and Lison, who freeze with one foot raised at the edge of a neat lawn. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Paper cut-out collage: layered coloured paper, crisp shadows
items.hook: 举手拦住不许做：interdire à 人 de 动词。

items.extra: remercier qqn de / pour qqch；de + 不定式；人是直接宾语：je la remercie
items.fr: Pia la [remercie de] son aide avec un grand sourire.
items.sen: Pia thanks her for her help with a big smile.
items.szh: 皮娅满脸笑容地感谢她的帮助。
items.scene: Pia hands a small bouquet to Ninon with a big grateful smile and a slight bow; behind them stands a neatly finished bookshelf they clearly built together, tools still nearby. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Paper cut-out collage: layered coloured paper, crisp shadows
items.hook: 感谢的是“人”（直接宾语 la），原因用 de：remercier 人 de。

items.extra: être prêt(e) à + 不定式
items.fr: Sac sur le dos, Lison [est prête à] partir en randonnée.
items.sen: With her rucksack on her back, Lison is ready to set off on a hike.
items.szh: 莉松背好了背包，准备出发去徒步。
items.scene: Lison stands at the start of a mountain trail with boots laced, rucksack on, walking poles in hand and one foot forward, giving a thumbs-up. Everything shows she is ready and has not left yet. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph print: two or three spot colours, grainy overlap, slight misregistration
items.hook: 准备好“去”做：prêt à。

items.en: to be glad to; to be happy about
items.extra: être content(e) de + 不定式 / 名词
items.fr: Ninon [est contente de] revoir ses amies après les vacances.
items.sen: Ninon is glad to see her friends again after the holidays.
items.szh: 假期过后，妮侬很高兴又见到朋友们。
items.scene: Ninon runs with open arms and a beaming face toward Pia and Lison at a station exit, suitcase left behind her. Her joy is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph print: two or three spot colours, grainy overlap, slight misregistration
items.hook: 因为什么而高兴，用 de：content de。

items.extra: être fier / fière de qqn / qqch / + 不定式
items.fr: Pia [est fière de] son premier gâteau au chocolat.
items.sen: Pia is proud of her first chocolate cake.
items.szh: 皮娅为自己做的第一个巧克力蛋糕感到骄傲。
items.scene: Pia, flour on her cheek and apron on, holds up a slightly lopsided chocolate cake with her chin raised and chest out, like presenting a trophy. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph print: two or three spot colours, grainy overlap, slight misregistration
items.hook: 骄傲的对象用 de：fier de。

items.en: to be able to; to be capable of
items.extra: être capable de + 不定式
items.fr: Lison [est capable de] nager deux kilomètres sans s'arrêter.
items.sen: Lison is able to swim two kilometres without stopping.
items.szh: 莉松能一口气游两公里。
items.scene: Lison swims strongly and easily across a wide lake, far from the shore behind her, with a calm, confident face; a distant buoy line shows the long distance. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph print: two or three spot colours, grainy overlap, slight misregistration
items.hook: 有本事做到：capable de。

items.en: to have to; to be obliged to
items.extra: être obligé(e) de + 不定式
items.fr: Sans ticket, Ninon [est obligée de] rentrer à pied.
items.sen: Without a ticket, Ninon has to walk home.
items.szh: 没有车票，妮侬只好走路回家。
items.scene: Ninon turns out her empty pockets in front of a closed metro gate, then is shown starting a long walk along the road with a resigned face while a tram drives away. No choice is the point. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph print: two or three spot colours, grainy overlap, slight misregistration
items.hook: 没得选，只好做：obligé de。

items.en: to be sure of; to be sure that one has
items.extra: être sûr(e) de + 不定式 / 名词
items.fr: Pia [est sûre d']avoir fermé la porte à clé.
items.sen: Pia is sure she locked the door.
items.szh: 皮娅确信自己把门锁好了。
items.scene: Pia walks away from her front door holding up the key confidently and nodding to a worried Lison who looks back at the door; a small memory bubble shows Pia's hand turning the key in the lock. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Risograph print: two or three spot colours, grainy overlap, slight misregistration
items.hook: 对某事有把握：sûr de。

items.extra: penser à qqn / qqch；代词：à lui / à elle（人），y（物）
items.fr: Dans le bus, Ninon [pense à] ses prochaines vacances au bord de la mer.
items.sen: On the bus, Ninon thinks about her next holiday by the sea.
items.szh: 妮侬在公共汽车上想着下一次去海边度假。
items.scene: Ninon sits on a bus looking dreamily out of the window; a thought bubble shows a beach with a parasol. Her mind is elsewhere: having something in mind is the point (not giving an opinion). Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 心里想着：penser à；问看法才是 penser de。

items.en: to think of (have an opinion about)
items.extra: penser qqch de qqn / qqch；常用于问句：Qu'est-ce que tu en penses ?
items.fr: Lison demande à Pia ce qu'elle [pense de] sa nouvelle robe.
items.sen: Lison asks Pia what she thinks of her new dress.
items.szh: 莉松问皮娅觉得她的新裙子怎么样。
items.scene: Lison twirls in a new dress in front of a mirror and looks questioningly at Pia, who studies the dress with a hand on her chin and gives a thumbs-up evaluation. Giving an opinion on something is the point (not daydreaming). Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 问“你觉得怎么样”：penser de；心里想着才是 penser à。

items.en: to play (a sport or a game)
items.extra: jouer à + 运动 / 游戏：jouer au tennis, aux cartes
items.fr: Le samedi, Pia [joue au] tennis avec sa cousine.
items.sen: On Saturdays, Pia plays tennis with her cousin.
items.szh: 每个星期六，皮娅和表妹打网球。
items.scene: Pia hits a tennis ball with a racket on a court, a young woman on the other side of the net. Sport equipment only, no musical instruments anywhere. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 球和游戏用 à：jouer au tennis；乐器用 de。

items.extra: jouer de + 乐器：jouer du piano, de la guitare
items.fr: Le soir, Lison [joue du] piano pour ses voisins.
items.sen: In the evening, Lison plays the piano for her neighbours.
items.szh: 晚上，莉松弹钢琴给邻居们听。
items.scene: Lison plays an upright piano by an open window in the evening while neighbours on nearby balconies listen happily; flowing music-note shapes without text. A musical instrument only, no sports equipment. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 乐器用 de：jouer du piano；球和游戏用 à。

items.extra: qqn manque à qqn：Tu me manques = 我想你（主语是被想念的人）
items.fr: Depuis son départ, Ninon [manque à] toute sa famille.
items.sen: Since she left, her whole family has missed Ninon.
items.szh: 妮侬离开以后，全家人都很想她。
items.scene: A family sits at a dinner table looking sadly at one empty chair with Ninon's blue scarf on it and her framed photo on the shelf; Ninon herself is absent. The empty place is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 法语里“被想念的人”做主语：Ninon manque à sa famille = 家人想念妮侬。

items.en: to lack; to be short of
items.extra: manquer de + 无冠词名词：manquer de temps, de sel
items.fr: Cette soupe [manque de] sel, dit Pia en la goûtant.
items.sen: This soup lacks salt, says Pia as she tastes it.
items.szh: 皮娅尝了尝说，这汤缺盐。
items.scene: Pia tastes soup from a spoon with a disappointed face and reaches for an empty salt shaker held upside down over the pot, nothing coming out. Something lacking is the point. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 缺什么：manquer de + 名词（不加冠词）；想念人才是 manquer à。

items.en: to speak to; to talk to
items.extra: parler à qqn；人用 lui / leur
items.fr: Avant le spectacle, Lison [parle à] son professeur de danse.
items.sen: Before the show, Lison talks to her dance teacher.
items.szh: 演出前，莉松在和她的舞蹈老师说话。
items.scene: Backstage, Lison in a dance costume speaks directly to her dance teacher face to face, a blank speech bubble pointing from her to the teacher. The person she is addressing is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 对“谁”说：parler à；说“什么事”是 parler de。

items.extra: parler de qqch / qqn；代词用 en：on en parle
items.fr: Au café, Ninon [parle de] son nouveau travail à ses amies.
items.sen: At the café, Ninon tells her friends about her new job.
items.szh: 在咖啡馆，妮侬和朋友们说起她的新工作。
items.scene: At a café table Ninon talks enthusiastically to Pia and Lison; her speech bubble contains a small picture of an office desk and a computer, showing the topic. The topic inside the bubble is the focus. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 说的“内容”用 de：parler de；说话的“对象”用 à。

items.extra: qqch sert à + 不定式 / 名词；À quoi ça sert ?
items.fr: Cette petite clé [sert à] ouvrir la boîte aux lettres.
items.sen: This little key is used to open the letterbox.
items.szh: 这把小钥匙是用来开信箱的。
items.scene: A close view of a small key next to a letterbox lock, with a dotted arrow from the key to the keyhole and an open letterbox with letters inside. The object's purpose is the point; no person is needed, a hand at most. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 东西的用途：servir à；人“使用”东西是 se servir de。

items.extra: se servir de qqch；代词用 en：je m'en sers
items.fr: Pia [se sert d']un dictionnaire pour comprendre le texte.
items.sen: Pia uses a dictionary to understand the text.
items.szh: 皮娅用词典来看懂这篇文章。
items.scene: Pia sits at a desk with a text in front of her, one finger on a line of the text and the other hand turning the pages of a thick open dictionary. A person actively using a tool is the point. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.style: Chibi cartoon: big heads, small bodies, rounded cute shapes, bright colours
items.hook: 人“用”工具：se servir de；工具“用来”做什么是 servir à。
